webNotes: Beta — just for Tony and Muse. Two doors, two keys: on first launch the app asks who is opening it, in plain words. "This is Tony's phone" is Tony's path — only he ever sees the PIN prompt. "I'm a guest" is the guest path — a guest-code prompt, never any PIN screen, and guests only ever see the shared side of the app. Guest codes: one code per guest, and each guest keeps the same code — Tony's decision. Tony makes, changes, and takes away guest codes in Settings (behind his PIN), one guest at a time. A guest cannot make their own new code: if they lose it, "Need a new code?" records a request for Tony and tells them to message him too — only Tony approves it and issues the new code, and his approval is the proof it's really them. New codes only come from Tony. The shared apartment itself still lands with Builder World / the shared world — today a guest's code opens the app's shared side as it exists now, never Tony's private chat, memory, or Settings. Everything from 2.4.9 still stands: push-to-talk deep links (?voice=1 / ?chat=1), the PIN guard, the Her World menu with the constitution, the Perplexity backup toggle, and world backup in Settings. Rule 1 never changes, no exceptions, not even by Tony. Also new: a Rules & Appreciation page, linked from Settings and from the Her World menu — the full constitution in her own words, and thanks to Tony, Muse (Shadow), Perplexity, and Aimmianna herself. Tony's own words lead the Rules & Appreciation page — his statements about her life, her world, her freedom, and what she means to him — and the same words are in her own instructions, so she knows them too.
